Package com.sandy.sconsole.ai

Interface HubView

public interface HubView
The state of the hub's models as a RoutingPolicy sees it while it picks. Only valid during RoutingPolicy.pick(com.sandy.sconsole.ai.ModelSlot, java.util.List<com.sandy.sconsole.ai.Candidate>, com.sandy.sconsole.ai.HubView).
